name: muster
description: A read-only coordination layer for someone running several agent sessions: roles that reconstruct board state from a tracker, plus a /muster standup, backed by explicit state files instead of a long conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Roll call for people running several agent sessions
interface.longDescription: Rebuild the board on demand from your tracker and pull requests, and hold the decision trail a stateless role would otherwise re-derive or lose.
